cert.pfxCompatHint: Windows Server 2016 / 2008 only accept SHA1 + 3DES PFX files. Switch compatibility mode if import fails (requires openssl on the server).
cert.importHint: Only PEM certificate and private key are accepted; they must be a matching pair (the backend verifies them against the public key). Imported certificates behave like issued ones: deployable, expiry-monitored, and exportable.

setting.titleHint: Shown as the sidebar / header title. Leave empty to use the built-in name.

setting.captchaOneHint: Default 1: one wrong password requires a captcha next time
setting.certLeadDaysHint: When a certificate has fewer days left than this, the scheduler alerts via the default notification channel.
setting.reverseProxyHint: Only rewrites the transport address; the ACME JWS keeps the original URL. Leave empty for the built-in default.
setting.versionHint: Provided by server project config; follows upgrades and migrations automatically.
setting.siteNameTip: Shown as the sidebar / header title; blank uses the built-in name
setting.subtitle: Subtitle

setting.logoPh: Blank uses the built-in icon; or paste an image URL

setting.policyScope: Applies to every account on this site
setting.loginFailLimitTip: Set 0 for no limit and no lockout
setting.force2faTip: Accounts without 2FA must set it up on next login
setting.captchaEnabled: Require a captcha after a wrong password
setting.captchaEnabledTip: When off, login only checks the password
setting.captchaAfterTip: Default 1: one wrong password and the next login needs a captcha
setting.expireDaysTip: When a certificate has fewer days left, the scheduler notifies through the default channel.
setting.proxyAlert: Same semantics as the env vars: httpProxy / httpsProxy / noProxy. With a proxy set, all outbound requests use it; noProxy hosts stay direct (supports localhost, .example.com, 192.168.*, 10.0.0.0/8).
setting.reverseTip: Only the transport address changes; ACME JWS still carries the original URL. Blank uses the built-in defaults.
setting.reverseValuePh: Reverse proxy domain, blank to disable
setting.aboutTip: These come from the server project config, so they follow upgrades and migrations automatically.
